answer: Faking thousands of identities means posting thousands of bonds, then watching them slashed when the overlap detector flags them, so the attack cost scales linearly while honest rewards stay modest. Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted admission: each agent must lock a bond that decays if its identity graph overlaps a known cluster, and peers attest only to agents whose bond survives a full epoch.
